hints.title: Consecutive Timestamp Differences
hints.text: Notice that each push duration is the difference between the current timestamp and the immediately preceding timestamp.

hints.title: First Event Handling
hints.text: The first button's duration is simply its own timestamp since no earlier press occurred.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rule
hints.text: Track the maximum duration, updating the chosen index if duration is strictly greater or if tied with a smaller index.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of button press events
complexity.notes: Single pass tracking maximum time difference with smallest index tie-breaking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory examining consecutive event timestamps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes adjacent timestamp differences and correctly resolves ties.
